facts.fact: Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 20.7 per cent of tertiary graduates in Burkina Faso in 2021, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 25.3 per cent of tertiary graduates in Burkina Faso in 2022, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 61.4 per cent of tertiary graduates in Burkina Faso in 2024, by UNESCO's series.
